name: Marshal Windsor
summary: You are sent to Blackrock Depths to learn what became of Marshal Windsor. Ragged John recalls that Windsor was dragged off to a prison.

sections.title: A Marshal Missing
sections.body: Ragged John remembers Marshal Windsor being taken away to a prison. From Blackrock Mountain, you are sent into Blackrock Depths to discover what became of him.

faq.answer: Marshal Windsor is the missing man you are sent to find in Blackrock Depths.
Ragged John recalls that Marshal Windsor was dragged off to a prison.

faq.q: Where do I look for Marshal Windsor?
faq.answer: You are sent to Blackrock Depths, inside Blackrock Mountain, to find out what became of him.
